title: Bitcoin Universe Inscribe BLOCK-20 emitted payload
description: Shape-only schema for compact JSON emitted by the current Bitcoin Universe Inscribe BLOCK-20 writer. It does not define token state, indexer acceptance, arithmetic semantics, active-chain status, or mint-hash freshness. Use block20-mint-hash.profile.schema.json when a canonical mint-hash profile is required.

des.description: The current endpoint may serialize a truthy JSON value. Canonical clients should use a string description.

hash.description: Backend-selected tip hash as emitted by the current writer. This shape schema intentionally does not assert canonical syntax or chain validity.
